rate_limit.label: Rate limit
rate_limit.description: Counts order attempts within a time window and rejects bursts beyond the cap. Rejected attempts still count, so retries cannot bypass it.

order_size_limit.label: Order size limit
order_size_limit.description: Caps the size of a single order by quantity and notional value to prevent fat-finger errors.

spot_funds_pnl_bounds_kill_switch.label: PnL Kill Switch
spot_funds_pnl_bounds_kill_switch.description: Uses engine-computed realized PnL in the account currency, net of optional passed commission. If a required input is missing, for example an FX quote needed to value realized PnL in the account currency, the engine blocks accounts under PnL control because it cannot guarantee the limit. FX is required only when needed: not for assets already in the account currency and not for accounts outside PnL control.

initial_pnl.label: initial PnL
initial_pnl.hint: decimal — sets the account-level starting realized PnL; account scope only
